policy: One national dataset carrying commune NIS codes as spine columns; local-area use filters the national dataset by geography, never per-area files. NIS code sets change across merger waves, so every commune-grain assignment and target declares its vintage and a mismatch is a compile error.

assignment_source.notes: Assignment distribution over communes within the record's observed NUTS1 region (SILC carries region; the spine assigns the commune).

geography_spine.notes: Generalizes the UK output-area rowwise clone-and-assign operators (uk_runtime/rowwise_dataset.py, rowwise_geography.py) with collision avoidance; the shared operator lands with the calibration-surface issue (populace#263). The 2025 NIS vintage postdates the 2019 merger wave; the old-to-merged crosswalk is ledger-be work (PolicyEngine/ledger#69).
